_doc: Star-charts (design/people/people-and-side-activities-spec.md §9; build item N-7.6.5): a riddle race on the night sky. A match is `rounds` riddles; first to `to_win` takes it. Each riddle shows its clues one at a time; answer at any clue, or ask for the next. An opponent answers once you wait past clue `buzz` (a range: seeded per riddle), right with chance `sure`; a wrong answer gives the riddle to the other side. tier: which riddles they ask (by riddle `tier`). tell: the habit you can read (`tell` explains it, `sign` is what you see when they're about to answer); learned the first time you beat them, for every life. stake: crowns a win pays (a loss costs it, if you have it). Riddles: kind (constellation, phase or sphere), three clues, the answer and four options (the answer among them); one you've answered right in any life shows its answer (Run.soul charts). A riddle's `rumour` is heard when you answer it right (a soft hint at a dated event).

wren.name: Wren
wren.tell: Wren hums while she's thinking. When the humming stops, she has it.

brogan.name: Brogan
brogan.tell: Brogan strokes his beard once he's sure. Not before.

marrow.name: Lector Marrow
marrow.tell: Marrow closes her eyes a breath before she answers.
